status_note: active, single-maintainer, tiny audience; cited in implementation-strategy.md
core_problem: Turn a short brief into a complete, SEO/GEO-ready, accessible Astro website by orchestrating an AI coding assistant (Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity) through a fixed sequence of skills, with quality gates, on a house stack of Astro -> GitHub -> Cloudflare Pages.
architecture: No runtime code of its own: the product is ~30 SKILL.md files under skills/ (ai-seo, business-listings-setup, copywriting, customer-research, image, independent-review, internal-link-audit, keystatic-setup, new-website, og-images, schema-markup, search-console-*, seo-audit, site-architecture, website-content-guide, website-design-system, website-motion, website-positioning, website-positioning-check, website-qa, website-review, website-seo-geo, website-testimonials, astro-i18n-setup...). new-website is the orchestrator: insights -> positioning -> content -> SEO/GEO -> design -> QA -> review -> launch. Skills carry references/ (playbooks, e.g. ai-seo/references/platform-ranking-factors.md, content-patterns.md) and evals/evals.json. Templates for the Astro scaffold live in skills/new-website/templates/. Repo tooling enforces hygiene: scripts/check_skill_budgets.sh (token budget per skill), check_model_agnostic.sh (skills must not depend on one vendor), check_template_coverage.sh, check_clean.sh; docs/reviews/ holds dozens of dated independent-review diffs, an audit trail of the suite reviewing its own changes. Sites are version-stamped with the suite version.
core_innovation: The whole agency process is encoded as versioned, budgeted, model-agnostic skill files with an independent-review skill that reviews the suite's own changes: process-as-code rather than app-as-code.
strengths: Pipeline shape matches ours almost exactly (positioning before design, QA and review as explicit stages, launch as a stage); validates the sequence.
Skill token budgets enforced by CI (check_skill_budgets.sh): a concrete answer to prompt bloat.
independent-review skill and docs/reviews/ trail: every change to the process gets a written review; maps to our 'drift review is a diff, not a write' rule.
Version stamping of built sites: the same idea as pinning library@commit in the manifest.
website-positioning-check exists as a separate skill from website-positioning: verification split from authoring.
Astro house stack independently chosen; keystatic-setup shows a git-backed CMS path for client edits without a database.
Search Console / business listings skills: post-launch measurement and local-SEO setup are treated as part of building the site.
weaknesses: Everything is prose instructions to a model; nothing is deterministic code. Quality depends entirely on the model following the SKILL.md; there is no gate that can fail a build.
No fact registry, no grounding leash: content is whatever the model writes from the brief.
No design library; 'design' is a skill describing principles, so output is model-invented layout, precisely the slop path.
4 stars, one maintainer; not a dependency, only a reference.
Positioning is elicited conversationally rather than declared as a typed value with honesty constraints.
patterns_to_steal: Stage list and ordering (insights -> positioning -> content -> SEO/GEO -> design -> QA -> review -> launch) -> confirms our selection pipeline; add their post-launch stages (search console, listings) to our launch checklist.
Skill/asset token budgets enforced in CI -> apply to playbooks, design systems and prompts: a playbook YAML over N tokens fails CI.
Model-agnostic check -> our three constrained calls should be tested against at least two providers so the pipeline is not vendor-shaped.
Dated review documents for every process change -> our /_proposed/<asset>@<date>.yml drift-review outputs should keep a review log alongside.
Version-stamp the site with library/playbook/design-system versions in a meta tag or build manifest served alongside the site.
patterns_to_avoid: Process-as-prose only -> cannot gate; our invariants must be code.
Conversational design decisions -> model invents layouts; we select authored arrangements.
Content generated without a fact registry -> unverifiable claims.
reusable_patterns: ProcessAsVersionedSkills: an agency workflow encoded as versioned instruction files with CI hygiene checks.
BudgetedPrompts: per-asset token ceilings enforced in CI.
SelfReviewTrail: every change to process assets produces a dated independent review artifact.
VersionStampedOutput: built sites record which process version built them.
adoption_strategy: Adapt. Take the stage ordering as confirmation, the CI hygiene scripts as a pattern for our YAML assets, and the post-launch SEO stages as checklist items. Do not adopt the skills themselves; they are prose where we need code.
